				AND = {

	has_character = RUS_mikhail_tomsky
	RUS_mikhail_tomsky = { NOT = { has_character_flag = is_dead } }
	OR = {
		has_country_leader = { character = RUS_mikhail_tomsky ruling_only = yes }
		RUS_mikhail_tomsky = { is_political_advisor = yes }
		RUS_mikhail_tomsky = { is_second_in_command = yes }
		AND = {
			RUS_mikhail_tomsky = { has_advisor_role = political_advisor }
			OR = {
				RUS_mikhail_tomsky = { is_political_advisor = yes }
				AND = {
					has_socialist_government = yes
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = RUS_stalin_psr_balance_collapse_done
					}
					RUS_mikhail_tomsky = { is_country_leader = no }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# RUS_nikolay_nekrasov — common/characters/RUS characters.txt
RUS_ddz_person_270485_eligible = {
	has_character = RUS_nikolay_nekrasov
	RUS_nikolay_nekrasov = { NOT = { has_character_flag = is_dead } }
	OR = {
		has_country_leader = { character = RUS_nikolay_nekrasov ruling_only = yes }
		RUS_nikolay_nekrasov = { is_political_advisor = yes }
		RUS_nikolay_nekrasov = { is_second_in_command = yes }
		AND = {
			RUS_nikolay_nekrasov = { has_advisor_role = second_in_command }
			OR = {
				RUS_nikolay_nekrasov = { is_second_in_command = yes }
				AND = {
					RUS_is_demrus = yes
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			RUS_nikolay_nekrasov = { has_advisor_role = political_advisor }
			OR = {
				RUS_nikolay_nekrasov = { is_political_advisor = yes }
				AND = {
					RUS_is_demrus = yes
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = RUS_stalin_psr_balance_collapse_done
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_government = market_liberal
						}
						has_completed_focus = RUS_republican_constitutional_clubs
					}
					else = {
						RUS_marlib_advisor = yes
					}
					always = yes
					RUS_nikolay_nekrasov = { is_country_leader = no }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# RUS_patriarch — common/characters/RUS characters.txt
RUS_ddz_person_154669_eligible = {
	has_character = RUS_patriarch
	RUS_patriarch = { NOT = { has_character_flag = is_dead } }
	OR = {
		has_country_leader = { character = RUS_patriarch ruling_only = yes }
		RUS_patriarch = { is_political_advisor = yes }
		RUS_patriarch = { is_second_in_command = yes }
		AND = {
			RUS_patriarch = { has_advisor_role = political_advisor }
			OR = {
				RUS_patriarch = { is_political_advisor = yes }
				AND = {
					has_socialist_government = no
					RUS_boldyrev = no
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = RUS_stalin_psr_balance_collapse_done
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							tag = RUS
						}
						OR = {
							has_completed_focus = RUS_dealing_with_faith
							has_completed_focus = RUS_state_orthodoxy
							has_completed_focus = RUS_ecumenic_council
							has_completed_focus = RUS_black_baron
						}
						has_country_flag = new_patriarch_elected
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							tag = FER
						}
						has_completed_focus = FER_empower_old_elites
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							tag = RSA
						}
						has_completed_focus = RSA_resistance_of_faithful
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# RUS_pavel_agyeyev — common/characters/RUS characters.txt
RUS_ddz_person_132117_eligible = {
	has_character = RUS_pavel_agyeyev
	RUS_pavel_agyeyev = { NOT = { has_character_flag = is_dead } }
	OR = {
		has_country_leader = { character = RUS_pavel_agyeyev ruling_only = yes }
		RUS_pavel_agyeyev = { is_political_advisor = yes }
		RUS_pavel_agyeyev = { is_second_in_command = yes }
		AND = {
			RUS_pavel_agyeyev = { has_advisor_role = political_advisor }
			OR = {
				RUS_pavel_agyeyev = { is_political_advisor = yes }
				AND = {
					has_government = national_populist
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = RUS_stalin_psr_balance_collapse_done
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							tag = RUS
							has_character = RUS_pyotr_krasnov
						}
						RUS_pyotr_krasnov = { is_hired_as_advisor = no }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
